correctness.rationale: The normalized one-wall polynomial generator has drift v d_u+(-a u-v+z)d_v, unit diffusion d_zz and reset r(f(u,v,0)-f); its closed degree-2/4 moment systems yield Var(v)=2/(a+r+r²) and the one-wall excess 6N/((4a+3)Q). Independence of the equal walls halves the standardized fourth cumulant, producing the claimed 3N/((4a+3)Q). Differentiating gives -3P/((4a+3)Q²), P=NQ_r-QN_r degree 14. The coefficient sign blocks have exactly two variations for every a>0 (the exceptional c11<0 implies a<3 and c10<0); P(a,0)>0, P(a,sqrt(a))<0 via an explicit all-positive H, and positive leading coefficient give exactly two SIMPLE positive roots on either side of sqrt(a). Thus the inverse three-value assertion is restricted to the open interval between the local minimum and maximum; all constants/rates strictly positive. Rebuilt independent 6/15 stationary moment solves at a=5/4,r=7/3 and checked the symbolic derivative/Descartes witnesses at five values, rather than relying on saved VERIFY_OK. The finite tests corroborate but are not the global two-root proof.
